# Overlay

> Overlay is the control plane for AI agents — one workspace to create,
> deploy, and manage every AI agent in one place. Bring your own agents
> (Codex, Claude Code, Hermes) or run Overlay's own, and put them to work in
> chat, Slack, Telegram, iMessage, and the web. Built by LayerNorm Inc.
> Open source under AGPL-3.0, with hosted and self-hosted options.

Overlay unifies AI agents: a single roster, shared context and memory,
per-agent computers, schedules and durable automations, spend and
permission controls, and audit trails — with a free tier that requires no
card.

## Product

- [Home](https://getoverlay.io/home): product overview — the control plane for AI agents
- [Pricing](https://getoverlay.io/pricing): free tier and paid plans
- [Download](https://getoverlay.io/download): Overlay Desktop for macOS
- [Manifesto](https://getoverlay.io/manifesto): why AI should amplify human potential
- [Self-hosting](https://getoverlay.io/self-hosting): run Overlay on infrastructure you control
